title: Oxy
description: Oxy adds a few optimization mods. It adds a huge boost of fps (1k FPS)
body:
# **Welcome to Oxy!**

## The Optimization pack of the decade
This modpack adds many preformance mods like Sodium, Ferrite Core, and more!
It can help your potato PC run shaders with stunning preformance.
Oxy can also download resource packs and shader packs through resourcify! (Credit to the Resourcify team) 
I made it with the intent to get my i7-2600 (A 2011 CPU along with my same-era GPU) to 1K FPS, and it worked.
The name Oxy comes from Oxygen due to it refrencing combustion and therefore preformance! :3
Oxy can make your potato run 1000 (Yes. 1K, I mean it.) FPS more on average (during testing)
Thanks for downloading Oxy!
